name: microsoft-365
description: Team Assistant MCP: an AI-native MCP server giving governed read/write access to Planner (including Goals), Teams, SharePoint and OneNote over Microsoft Graph. Self-hosted, per-tenant, delegated sign-in — no central service, no admin-consent-for-others.

TEAM_ASSISTANT_TENANT_ID.title: Entra directory (tenant) ID
TEAM_ASSISTANT_TENANT_ID.description: Directory (tenant) ID from the Entra app registration Overview blade. Not a secret. Set once here at user scope and every chat and project loads Team Assistant with it.

TEAM_ASSISTANT_CLIENT_ID.title: Entra application (client) ID
TEAM_ASSISTANT_CLIENT_ID.description: Application (client) ID from the same Overview blade. Not a secret. Set once here at user scope and every chat and project loads Team Assistant with it.
